description_en: Retrieves the number of baseline check issues for a container cluster
description_zh: 获取容器集群基线检查问题个数
kebab_example: aliyun sas get-cluster-check-item-warning-statistics --cluster-id cd49575861a3044d49c954e4b39110000 --uuid ae1527a9-2308-46ab-b10a-48ae7ff70000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetClusterCheckItemWarningStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the container cluster that you want to query.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的容器集群的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server.
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
服务器UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

Data.description_en: The baseline check statistics grouped by risk level (high, medium, and low)
Data.description_zh: 基线检查按照高中低等级统计数据

HighWarningCount.description_en: The number of high-risk check items

LowWarningCount.description_en: The number of low-risk check items

MediumWarningCount.description_en: The number of medium-risk check items

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
